privacy.intro: dhp hospitality Inc. (hereinafter "the Company") considers the protection of personal information an important responsibility and hereby establishes this Privacy Policy.
privacy.section1Body:
We may collect personal information in the following circumstances:
• Inquiries submitted through our contact form
• Service applications
• Event and seminar registrations

Information collected may include your name, company name, email address, and phone number.
privacy.section2Body:
Personal information collected is used for the following purposes:
• Responding to inquiries
• Providing and improving our services
• Notifications about new services and events
• Compliance with applicable laws
privacy.section3Body: We will not provide personal information to third parties without consent, except as required by law.
privacy.section4Body: We implement appropriate security measures to maintain the accuracy of personal information and prevent unauthorized access, loss, damage, alteration, or leakage.
privacy.section5Body: For inquiries regarding the handling of personal information, please contact us through our inquiry form.

hotelDev.headline:
Weaving the Stories of Place
into One-of-a-Kind Hotels
hotelDev.lead: From site selection to design, construction, and operations. Through an integrated development process, we create one-of-a-kind spaces rooted in the essence of each locale.
hotelDev.approach1Body: Thorough analysis of location potential. We deeply understand the history, culture, and natural environment to build concepts unique to each site.
hotelDev.approach2Body: Collaborating with leading architects and designers to bring concepts to life in space. We pursue quality down to the finest detail, creating environments that engage all five senses.
hotelDev.approach3Body: Comprehensive planning that envisions post-opening strategies. We deliver sustainable value creation from day one.
hotelDev.strength1: A philosophy of 'supporting people,' cultivated in medical and care services
hotelDev.strength2: Integrated development capabilities from site selection to operations
hotelDev.strength3: Concept design that weaves the narratives of place

brandAttraction.headline:
Bringing World-Class Brands
to the Japanese Stage
brandAttraction.lead: Through negotiation and attraction of premier hotel brands worldwide, we maximize project value with optimal brand matching.
brandAttraction.approach1Body: Continuous research into the global hotel market. We accumulate insights to select the perfect brand for each project.
brandAttraction.approach2Body: Direct negotiations with brand headquarters, presenting project appeal while securing optimal terms for both parties.
brandAttraction.approach3Body: Supporting franchise and management contract execution. We provide consistent guidance throughout the process to opening day.
brandAttraction.strength1: Extensive network with global hotel brands
brandAttraction.strength2: Negotiation expertise that maximizes project value
brandAttraction.strength3: Consistent support from contract to grand opening

fcManagement.headline:
Creating Sustainable Value
through Proven Operations
fcManagement.lead: Hotel operations management through the franchise model. With accumulated expertise and proprietary operational standards, we deliver sustainable returns and exceptional guest experiences.
fcManagement.approach1Body: Designing optimal operational frameworks tailored to each hotel's characteristics. We achieve the balance between efficiency and genuine hospitality.
fcManagement.approach2Body: Maintaining and elevating service quality based on proprietary standards. Through staff training programs, we ensure consistently exceptional service.
fcManagement.approach3Body: Leveraging revenue management methodologies to optimize earnings. We support sustainable business operations with data-driven strategies.
fcManagement.strength1: Proprietary operational standards and quality management systems
fcManagement.strength2: Staff training programs ensuring consistent service excellence
